verdict.rationale: Bento documents broadcasts as one-time marketing sends to a broad audience or saved segment. The API can create campaigns and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules, including exclusive_tags to leave out recipients, and saved segments plus a custom segment builder handle audience picking. Composing is supported by plain-text or drag-and-drop email templates, though that editor is described in the sequences docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-app broadcast composer and immediate 'send now' flow (most evidence is API/CLI-centric), and independent hands-on corroboration of the campaign-sending loop.
